paragraphs: Circuit runs electric, on-demand shuttle services with cities, transit agencies, special districts, and private partners. Its stated mission is to provide low-cost, accessible, and eco-friendly rides to all.

The shuttles cover short distances, offering first and last-mile connections to mass transit and letting visitors park only once. Riders hail them by downloading an app. Partners and advertisers underwrite the service, which is offered at low cost or free. The company says it connects riders in transit deserts and offers wheelchair-accessible vehicle options.

The fleet has been all-electric since 2011. The site says over 8 million rides have been provided without burning an ounce of gas. Rides are available in more than 40 markets across the United States, from California to New York and Florida to Massachusetts. Case studies on the site describe partners nationwide. One headline describes activating downtown Orlando with free, electric microtransit.
